preparation_condition: Complete untimed transcript in advance. No original video frames, caption timings, datasets or images supplied to the follower. Operator may clarify ambiguity before approval.

evaluation.audio_queue: latest available simulated from measured recognition costs
evaluation.reference: Operator-authored sections fixed before inspecting follower results; six-second boundary exclusion, source-dependent overlaps declared.
evaluation.visual_review: Sample original frames before replay; record whether prepared visuals preserve required relationships/evidence. Qualitative implementation-operator review, not audience study.
checks: missing visual evidence or supplied datasets
evaluation.browser_verification: Previously declined; compare saved traces and native original frames, generate local players without browser automation.

limits: Two additional development tests, not a representative corpus.
Shared complete transcript is generous semantic preparation; absent datasets/images constrain visual fidelity.
The original presentation is a reference rather than the only valid design.
No source assets, transcripts or credentials will be committed.
